name: newsplus-workspace
description: Newsplus — AI-powered news monitoring, summarisation, translation & report writing

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,FRONT -c blue,green "npm run dev -w newsplus-API" "npm run dev -w newsplus-front"
scripts.build: npm run build -w newsplus-API && npm run build -w newsplus-front
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @newsplus/shared && npm run typecheck -w newsplus-API && npm run typecheck -w newsplus-front
scripts.test: npm run test -w newsplus_api && npm run test -w newsplus-front
